'''Murtazin Khairulla Khabibullovich '''  ({{langx|ru|Муртазин Хайрулла Хабибуллович}}; 4 January 1941 – 17 November 2016) was a Russian [[mathematician]]. Since 1978 he has been the Head of the Chair of Mathematical analysis [[Bashkir State University]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.bashedu.ru/sotrudniki-kafedry-matematicheskogo-analiza/ |title=Bashkir State University site |access-date=2014-09-28 |archive-date=2016-03-04 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304063036/http://www.bashedu.ru/sotrudniki-kafedry-matematicheskogo-analiza/ |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>[http://posredi.ru/Doc/BashGU/m/murtazinhh.htm  Bashkir State University site] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141006080035/http://posredi.ru/Doc/BashGU/m/murtazinhh.htm |date=2014-10-06 }}</ref><ref>[http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?personid=8756&option_lang=rus www.mathnet.ru]</ref>

==Biography==
Murtazin was born in the village Aznash in [[Uchalinsky District]], now in [[Bashkortostan]]. He graduated from the Department of Mathematics of [[Bashkir State University]] and defended his doctoral thesis in 1994. Since 1978 until the present day he is the head of the [[Mathematical Analysis]] chair of the department<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.wiki02.ru/encyclopedia/Murtazin_Hayrulla_Habibullovich/t/9269|title=Муртазин Хайрулла Хабибуллович}}</ref>

Scientific activity is devoted to problems of quantum mechanics.

Murtazin investigated the asymptotic behavior of the discrete spectrum of the [[Schrödinger equation|Schrödinger operator]], the spectrum of perturbations of partial differential operators, results on the two-particle operators in the class of integrable potentials, conditions for the existence of virtual particles 4. The results of the studies were used in the work on [[quantum mechanics]], nuclear physics and acoustics, for geological and seismic work research and design institute of well logging VNIIGIS ([[Oktyabrsky, Republic of Bashkortostan]]).

Author of more than 70 scientific papers.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2016-11-17 |title=В Уфе ушел из жизни профессор Хайрулла Муртазин |url=https://veteranrb.ru/v-ufe-ushel-iz-zhizni-professor-hajrulla-murtazin/ |access-date=2024-09-25 |website=Ветеран Башкортостана |language=ru-RU}}</ref>

== Awards and honours ==

* 2003 – Honored worker of science of the Republic of Bashkortostan<ref name=":0" />
* 2008 – Honorary Worker of Higher specialized Education of the Russian Federation<ref name=":0" />
* 2011 – laureate of the State Prize of the Republic of Bashkortostan in the field of science and technology<ref name=":0" />
